description: Calculate what an amount of money from one year is worth in another year, cumulative inflation %, average annual inflation rate and year-by-year CPI table for 190+ countries using official World Bank WDI CPI data (CC BY 4.0). Runs on our server, files are deleted right after the call, nothing stored. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €9/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.001/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/inflation-calculator.

amount.description: Amount of money to adjust, e.g. 1000

compareCountry.description: Optional second ISO-3 country code to compare inflation side by side

country.description: ISO-3 country code, e.g. USA, DEU, GBR, FRA, BGR

toYear.description: Ending year (optional, defaults to latest available CPI year)

name: inflation_calculator
title: Inflation Calculator API - historical purchasing power across 190+ countries (World Bank CPI)
